title: When the Harbor Breaks
author: August Villalobos
blurb: Mirabel Halloran, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
